title: Engaging the overdrive
description: With Boba Fett and his Tusken Raider companions having edged closer and closer to the repulsor train's control car, they are temporarily pinned down by the Pyke offensive. An incredibly bold Tusken crashed a speeder into the train, jumped aboard, and severed the entire rear portion of the train. The explosion rocked the massive silver locomotive, garnering the attention of the Droid engineer, who fires the boosters into overdrive!
